title: Kernel component of the completion projection formula
statement: theorem flat_and_quotients_projection_kernel (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) : ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : C), RingHom.ker ((projection J A I n).hom.app (op U)).hom = Ideal.span (Set.range (fun a : ↥(I ^ (n + 1)) ↦ (algebraSection (coefficientMap J A I) a).val (op U)))

proof.text: The quotient tensor comparison identifies the kernel with the extended power of the coefficient ideal; identify its sectionwise generators with algebraSection.
